title: AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dexterous manipulation is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, but scaling it remains difficult because robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and action spaces vary across embodiments. Policies trained on heterogeneous data can also entangle task-relevant visual cues with embodiment-specific appearance, limiting cross-embodiment generalization. We present AdvDex, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for learning dexterous manipulation from human and robot demonstrations. First, we introduce OmniShare, a large-scale multimodal dataset of human manipulation demonstrations that provides high-quality kinematic supervision and tactile measurements while reducing reliance on robot teleoperation. Second, we propose the Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), a canonical action representation comprising an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ wrist pose and 15 finger joints, thereby functionally aligning human hands, dexterous robot hands,

translated_title: AdvDex：通过关节对齐动作与对抗性学习从人类演示中学习灵巧操作
translated_abstract: 灵巧操作是具身智能的基础能力，但由于机器人演示数据收集成本高昂且不同实体间的动作空间存在差异，其规模化仍然困难。在异构数据上训练的策略也可能将任务相关的视觉线索与实体特定的外观纠缠在一起，限制了跨实体的泛化能力。我们提出了AdvDex，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于从人类和机器人演示中学习灵巧操作。首先，我们引入了OmniShare，一个大规模的多模态人类操作演示数据集，提供高质量的动力学监督和触觉测量，同时减少对机器人遥操作的依赖。其次，我们提出了关节对齐动作空间（JAAS），一种规范的动作表示，包含一个$\mathrm{SE}(3)$腕部姿态和15个手指关节，从而在功能上对齐人类手部、灵巧机器人手部以及其他实体。
tldr: AdvDex通过引入大规模人类演示数据集OmniShare和关节对齐动作空间（JAAS），结合对抗性学习，实现了从异构演示中学习灵巧操作并提升跨实体泛化能力。
en_tdlr: AdvDex enables learning dexterous manipulation from heterogeneous demonstrations by introducing the OmniShare large-scale human demonstration dataset and a Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), coupled with adversarial learning to enhance cross-embodiment generalization.
